formal_name: CUBE-REV Generation VII G7-P16-R3 — Fixed-Rank Raw Exact-State Latent vs Handcrafted Search-Coordinate Policy Representation Tournament, Stage-Held-Out Cross-Cohort Likelihood, Equal-Rank Capacity Control, Representation-Specific Information Gain, Metadata Firewall & Fresh-Confirmation Qualification Tournament
interpretation: Handcrafted exact-search coordinates outperform the equal-rank raw cubie-state latent representation on all four held-out development stages.
The result favors search/action-support structure as a more transport-efficient representation than the current raw-state embedding family.
This remains development evidence and does not imply that humans explicitly compute H1/H2/H3/FS/TS or phase1 quantities.
Before spending fresh confirmation authority, test whether raw-state information adds complementary predictive value when combined with handcrafted coordinates.
